summary: GitHub issue and commit-status reads use the gh-ci installation once its token grants them

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Behaviour is unchanged until an operator-published gh-ci sidecar grants issues or statuses read; forbidden installation reads still replay with the PAT.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

manual.detail: Granting Issues and Commit statuses read to the gh-ci App moves those reads off the PAT; no action is required otherwise.

recovery.detail: Revoking the permissions returns those reads to the PAT on the next token refresh.
